notes: Adding an agent: copy prompts/agents/_template/ to prompts/agents/<key>/, fill persona.md, questions.md and cv.md, then add one entry above (order controls display and Round 1 column position; grid=true puts the agent in the 3/4/5-column layout; in_round1=true means it speaks independently in the parallel Round 1). name is the person's first name — it is how the moderator and the other agents address them, and how a mention in one agent's prose is linked to the speaker it names, so it must match the name in that agent's persona.md. function is the discipline the person covers, used wherever the role matters more than the person (report sections, RAG rows, action owners). label is name and function together and is what appears on message headers, column headers and both exports. colour/colour_soft drive the chip, column header, message rule and both exports. No code change needed beyond reading this file. Agents are country-agnostic: {{COUNTRY}} comes from the session's own inputs, and every country-specific fact is identified by the agent's own search each turn, not baked into these files.
